				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_authored_24_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_authored_24 } }
			}
			add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_acquisition_candidates target = flag:work_authored_24 }
		}
	}
}
